notes.title: 🎮 Asylum Nightmares available on Steam Deck!!! 🎮
notes.content:
🎮 AVAILABLE ON STEAM DECK 🎮 
I'm happy to announce that Asylum Nightmares is now available on Steam Deck.

This is an early release, with updates to be released throughout the month of November.

It's not officially available due to Steam policies, but it's fully functional.

[previewyoutube=ZSA9p-C36kY;full][/previewyoutube]

Regards. 😎
Thank you very much. 🎉

notes.title: 🎃 Asylum Nightmares 1.2 out now! Happy Halloween!!! 🎃
notes.content:
I'm glad to say that this update is very special. I've managed to reduce the size of the game to less than 2 GB. I've improved the performance of the game by reducing many technical aspects.

ːsteamthisː New Improvements ːsteamthisː
- Added new event for Halloween.
- Zombies have pumpkins on their heads temporarily.
- More lights have been added to the scene.
- The zombies get stronger with each wave.
- The door prices have changed.
[previewyoutube=mUvn27bNZgc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

ːsteamthumbsupː Bug Fixes ːsteamthumbsupː
- Fixed bugs in Horde Mode.
[previewyoutube=igYnI53dRCY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


Thank you very much for the support and patience.

notes.title: Asylum Nightmares 1.0 out now!
notes.content:
In this update, I've focused on enhancing the player experience by addressing key bugs and introducing new features. My primary goal has been to optimize game performance, resolve issues reported by the community, and refine certain elements to ensure smoother gameplay. Below is a summary of the improvements and fixes we've implemented.

ːsteamthisː New Improvements ːsteamthisː
- Added new Horde Mode.
- Added more sprinting stamina.
- Added performance improvements.
- Added more languages.
[previewyoutube=mUvn27bNZgc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

ːsteamthumbsupː Bug Fixes ːsteamthumbsupː
- Fixed issue with weapon instancing.
- Crates not appearing in early levels.
- Fixed bugs with Twitch connection.
- Fixed issues with level restart.
[previewyoutube=igYnI53dRCY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


Thank you very much for the support and patience.
